$comment: Which lines of the raw extraction each chapter's prose was built from.
This is what makes the zero-rewording check a diff rather than a search:
the test rebuilds the expected text stream from these spans and asserts
equality with the shipped MDX, so a deleted sentence, a truncated clause
or a reordered paragraph fails just as loudly as a changed number.
Spans are [page, firstLine, lastLine], 1-based and inclusive, and must be
listed in the order the chapter uses them. Lines left out of every span
are table rows (deferred to T-006), citation-marker footers, Khmer, or
English front matter — see SOURCES.md for why each one is excluded.

excludedProse.why: The second crop table's sub-heading. Its sibling 5.1 is captioned in English and Khmer only, so shipping 5.2 alone would produce a lone numbered heading. Deferred to T-006, which owns both tables and their captions.
